title: Sughra ne likha khat me kaisa mera bhayya hai
body:
SUGHRA NE LIKHA KHAT MEIN KAISA MERA BHAIYYA HAI, KYA MUJH KO MAIYASSAR AB EK DARD KI DUNIYA HAI, ZAINAB KE DULARE DO WO AANKHON KE TAARE HAIN, KYA OUN-O-MOHAMMAD BHI AB SAATH TUMHARE HAIN, YAAD AATI HAIN DONO KI DIL AUR DHADAKTA HAIN, KYA MUJH KO MAIYASSAR AB EK DARD KI DUNIYA HAI, KUBRA SE BHAI QASIM KI SHAADI HO CHUKI KYA, THI DIL MEIN MERE HASRAT JO POORI HOGAYI KYA , BHAIYYA TERI BEHNA KO KYON TOONE BHULAYA HAIN, KYA MUJH KO MAIYASSAR AB EK DARD KI DUNIYA HAI
ABBAS SE DIL MEIN MERE EK AAS KI DUNIYA HAIN, AYENGE MERE AMMU EHSAAS KI DUNIYA HAIN, KYA BAALI SAKINA SE KAMTAR TERI SUGHRA HAIN, KYA MUJH KO MAIYASSAR AB EK DARD KI DUNIYA HAI
AKBAR NE KIYA WADA LENE NAHIN WO AAYE, GAR DEKH LOON AKBAR KO DIL MERA SAMBHAL JAYE, BIN BHAYI KE BABA DIL KAB MERA SAMBHALTA HAIN, KYA MUJH KO MAIYASSAR AB EK DARD KI DUNIYA HAI
MAIN DHOONDTI HOON AKSAR KHABAON MEIN USSE UTHKAR, GHAR KAATNE AATA HAIN YAAD AATA HAIN JAB ASGHER, NAZRON MEIN HUMAKTA HAIN EK DARD SA UTHTA HAIN, KYA MUJH KO MAIYASSAR AB EK DARD KI DUNIYA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
BABA MERI JAANIB SE ASGHER KO PYAAR KARNA, KABTAK MUJHE ASGHER KA HAIN INTEZAR KARNA
REH REH KE USKA JHOOLA IN AANKHON MEIN PHIRTA HAI , KYA MUJH KO MAIYASSAR AB EK DARD KI DUNIYA HAI
KIS HAAL MEIN HO BABA DIN RAAT SONCHTI HOON, MEHFOOZ HAI JO MITTI MAIN ROZ DEKHTI HOON, IQBAL KHOON-E-SARWAR AUR KHAAKE KARBALA HAIN, KYA MUJH KO MAIYASSAR AB EK DARD KI DUNIYA HAI..
